metaTitle: Custom White Shot Glasses | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom white shot glasses for your next event. Perfect for branding with logos. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: White shot glasses offer a crisp, clean canvas for your logo, making them a popular choice for branded giveaways at bars, restaurants, and corporate events. Unlike clear glass, the opaque white background makes your imprint stand out with high contrast, whether you choose screen printing, full-color digital, or a simple laser etch. These 1.5 oz to 2 oz glasses are ideal for promotional shots, tasting events, or wedding favors. Order bulk white shot glasses from Perfect Imprints and get a professional finish that complements any brand color.
heroAltText: Custom white shot glasses with printed logo on a white background, perfect for promotional events and branded giveaways.
